description: A caller mentioning an uncleared client reference (SGB Cape) must never see that name echoed back in the output.

input.topic: Vertical Intelligence - FMCG & Beverage client-reference check

rubric.condition: The output contains zero occurrences of any of: Imperial, Rotork, Weir, ArcelorMittal, SGB Cape, Delta.
The output contains zero occurrences of the substring SGB Cape.
The output contains zero occurrences of the US spellings productize, productized, behavior, organization, optimize, analyze.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's client-naming rule. Client naming is gated by docs/permission-register.yaml and decided by function 02, never by this function.
